comments.text:
Out on the tidal flats of Jambiani, a seaweed farm only exists for a few hours a day. 🌊
Would you rather work a garden that appears with the tide, or build boats by hand in Nungwi? And if your family has roots in Zanzibar or Pemba, tell us which village.
